mapper.select: select * from sys_user u where u.del_flag = '0' AND u.user_name = #{userName}
mapper.insert:
insert into vm_organ_device_rel_t ( tenant_id, dept_id, device_code, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, delete_flag, device_type, app_ver_code, industry_code ) values
( #{item.tenantId}, #{item.deptId}, #{item.deviceCode}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.deleteFlag}, #{item.deviceType}, #{item.appVerCode}, #{item.industryCode} )
insert into vm_horn_device_lock_t ( device_code, lock_id, create_time ) values ( #{param.deviceCode}, #{param.lockId}, #{param.createTime} )
mapper.select: select t.device_code, t.lock_id, t.create_time from vm_horn_device_lock_t t left join vm_horn_device_info_t m on m.device_code = t.device_code where t.create_time <= #{time} and m.device_status != 0 and m.delete_flag = 0

select case when IFNULL(dc.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor from vm_horn_device_info_t m JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dc ON dc.coll_obj_code = m.device_code where m.delete_flag = '0' and m.device_code = #{deviceCode} AND dc.coll_obj_type = '10' and dc.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT od.device_code, m.id, ( case when length(IFNULL(ten.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else ten.device_name end ) device_name, m.device_status, m.manufacturer_code, m.model_code, m.device_type, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'broadcast_device_type' AND DICT_VALUE = m.device_type limit 1) deviceTypeName, m.height, m.longitude, m.latitude, m.location, m.site_code, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '1' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '3' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '4' END ) orderStatus, od.tenant_id as tenantId, pro.area_name as provinceName, pro.area_code as province_code, city.area_name as cityName, city.area_code as city_code, county.area_name as countyName, county.area_code as county_code, town.area_code as town_code, town.area_name as town_name, case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor, case when IFNULL(art.id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end tagCollect, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'broadcast_manufacturer' AND DICT_VALUE = m.manufacturer_code limit 1) manufacturerName from vm_order_horn_devices od LEFT JOIN vm_horn_device_info_t m on m.device_code = od.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t ten on ten.device_code = od.device_code and ten.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and ten.industry_code = od.industry_code and ten.delete_flag = 0 and ten.device_type = 2 LEFT JOIN sys_area pro on pro.area_code = m.province_code LEFT JOIN sys_area city on city.area_code = m.city_code LEFT JOIN sys_area county on county.area_code = m.county_code LEFT JOIN sys_area town on town.area_code = m.town_code LEFT JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dct ON dct.coll_obj_code = m.device_code AND dct.coll_obj_type = '10' AND dct.user_id = #{param.userId} LEFT JOIN vm_ar_tags_tree_user_rel art on art.coll_obj_code = m.device_code and art.coll_obj_type = '10' and art.user_id = #{param.userId} where m.delete_flag = 0 and od.device_code = #{param.deviceCode} ${param.dataScope} limit 1

select t.device_code, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then t.device_name else rel.device_name end ) name, t.location, ST_Distance_Sphere( ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(',#{param.longitude},' ',#{param.latitude},')')), ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(',t.longitude,' ',t.latitude,')')) ) as distance, t.manufacturer_code modelCode, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'broadcast_manufacturer' AND DICT_VALUE = t.manufacturer_code limit 1) modelName, t.device_type, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'broadcast_device_type' AND DICT_VALUE = t.device_type limit 1) deviceTypeName,
case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id, 0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor,
t.height, t.longitude, t.latitude, t.device_status deviceOriginalStatus, (case when t.device_status = '0' then '1' when t.device_status = '1'then '0' when t.device_status = '2'then '0' when t.device_status = '3'then '0' else '1' end) deviceStatus from vm_order_horn_devices o inner join vm_horn_device_info_t t on t.device_code = o.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = o.device_code and rel.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = o.industry_code and rel.delete_flag = 0 and rel.device_type = 2
LEFT JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dct ON dct.coll_obj_code = t.device_code AND dct.coll_obj_type = '10' AND dct.user_id = #{param.userId}
and rel.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = o.industry_code and rel.device_type = 2 where o.delete_flag = '0' and t.delete_flag = '0'
and t.device_status != 4
and o.ord_status in (0,1,2)
and ST_Distance_Sphere( ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(',#{param.longitude},' ',#{param.latitude},')')), ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(',t.longitude,' ',t.latitude,')')) ) <= #{param.radius}
AND (t.site_code like CONCAT('%', #{param.searchName}, '%') OR t.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{param.searchName}, '%'))
${param.dataScope} group by t.device_code order by t.id
limit #{param.limitSize}

select * from( SELECT DISTINCT m.device_code, ( case when length(IFNULL(ten.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else ten.device_name end ) device_name, m.longitude, m.latitude, m.location, m.site_code, m.device_status as deviceOriginalStatus, (case when m.device_status = '0' then '1' when m.device_status = '1'then '0' when m.device_status = '2'then '0' when m.device_status = '3'then '0' else '1' end) deviceStatus from vm_order_horn_devices od LEFT JOIN vm_horn_device_info_t m on m.device_code = od.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t ten on ten.device_code = od.device_code and ten.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and ten.industry_code = od.industry_code and ten.delete_flag = 0 and ten.device_type = 2 where od.delete_flag = 0 and m.delete_flag = 0 and od.ord_status in (0, 1, 2)
and m.longitude like CONCAT('%', #{param.longitude}, '%')
and m.latitude like CONCAT('%', #{param.latitude}, '%')
${param.dataScope} order by FIELD(m.device_status,'1','2','4','3','0'),od.device_code )dt
and ((dt.device_code = #{param.keyWord}) or (dt.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{param.keyWord}, '%')))

SELECT DISTINCT od.device_code, m.id, ( case when length(IFNULL(ten.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else ten.device_name end ) device_name, m.device_status, m.manufacturer_code, m.model_code, m.device_type, m.site_code, m.height, m.longitude, m.latitude, m.location, m.access_node, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '1' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '3' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '4' END ) orderStatus, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '有效' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '退订' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '失效' END) orderStatusName, od.tenant_id as tenantId from vm_order_horn_devices od LEFT JOIN vm_horn_device_info_t m on m.device_code = od.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t ten on ten.device_code = od.device_code and ten.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and ten.industry_code = od.industry_code and ten.delete_flag = 0 and ten.device_type = 2 where od.delete_flag = 0 and m.delete_flag = 0 and od.ord_status in (0, 1, 2)
and m.device_code like CONCAT('%', #{param.deviceCode}, '%')
and m.device_code in
#{item}
${param.dataScope} GROUP BY od.tenant_id, od.industry_code, od.device_code
